_comment: Railway template definition for a Lite-mode StingStream coordinator.
Deploy from the published image rather than building from source: the repository is a
monorepo with five vendored upstreams, and Railway would otherwise upload and build all of
it. The image is published by .github/workflows/coordinator.yml on every push to master.
TLS is deliberately `none`: Railway's proxy terminates TLS in front of the container, and the
coordinator serves plain HTTP on $PORT. Everything else defaults to a working relay plus
rendezvous; the DNS variables are only needed for the HTTPS side door.

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_MODE.description: lite (this template) or full (needs a VPS with UDP and a delegated DNS zone)

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_TLS.description: Railway terminates TLS in front of the container, so the coordinator serves plain HTTP

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_HOSTNAME.description: This service's public hostname, without a scheme. Set it to the generated Railway domain.

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_DNS_ORIGIN.description: Optional. The zone the HTTPS side door lives under, e.g. direct.example.org.

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_DNS_PROVIDER.description: Optional. none | cloudflare | mock. Lite mode is not authoritative, so side-door records are published through a provider API.

STINGSTREAM_COORDINATOR_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE.description: Optional. Cloudflare zone id for the domain above.

STINGSTREAM_DNS_TOKEN.description: Optional. A zone-scoped Cloudflare API token with Zone:DNS:Edit on that one zone, and nothing else.
